Container.Name: couloir
Container.Overview: Couloir: a personal backcountry ski route library. Serves the web app and its API on one port, with data in a SQLite database and photo files under /data. No authentication: keep it on your LAN or tailnet and never port-forward it.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the app and API are served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (couloir.db), photos/ and daily backups/. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Maptiler API key
Config.Description: Optional. Used by browsers that haven't entered their own key.
